links.outcome: Readability of LLM lay summaries of radiology reports (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Reading Ease)
links.effect: Gemini 1.5 Pro produced the most accessible summaries (FKGL 7.55 ± 1.38, Flesch Reading Ease 67.84 ± 7.78); readability varied across LLM-prompt combinations.
links.quote: Gemini 1.5 - Pro produced the most accessible summaries (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level: 7.55 ± 1.38, Flesch Reading Ease: 67.84 ± 7.78).

links.outcome: Agreement between blinded expert radiology fellows and reasoning-model raters on summary quality
links.effect: Strong agreement between experts and LRMs, with 0.96% (LRM 1) and 3.4% (LRM 2) complete disagreement.
links.quote: Strong agreement was observed between experts and LRMs [0.96% (LRM 1) and 3.4% (LRM 2) complete disagreement].

unlisted_practices: Using large reasoning models as automated evaluators of LLM-generated lay summaries
Tailored prompting strategies (few-shot, generated knowledge, zero-shot) to improve lay summary quality

screen.reason: The study benchmarks several LLMs paired with specific prompting styles (few-shot, zero-shot, generated knowledge) evaluated by clinicians and reasoning models for lay summarization of radiology reports, but it does not test a deployable organizational safeguard or compare outcomes with/without a deployment practice.
